task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output or file explorer showing the creation of /home/ga/SUMO_Output/baseline_emissions.xml.

task_completion.description: Implement LEZ by restricting high-polluting vehicles on at least five core edges.

task_completion.description: Apply at least two distinct restriction strategies (e.g., vehicle class bans and lane-specific restrictions).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots of configuration files showing two different methods of restriction, such as modifying edge permissions and changing vehicle type definitions.

task_completion.description: Generate the LEZ emission XML output after implementing restrictions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal output or file explorer showing the creation of /home/ga/SUMO_Output/lez_emissions.xml.

task_completion.description: Produce a CSV report with specific columns (pollutant, baseline_total_mg, lez_total_mg, reduction_pct) for CO2, CO, NOx, PMx, and HC.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A view of /home/ga/SUMO_Output/emission_impact_report.csv containing the required columns and data for all five pollutants.

task_completion.description: Document LEZ design, numerical results, and policy recommendations in a summary text file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A view of /home/ga/SUMO_Output/emission_impact_summary.txt containing text descriptions of the LEZ design and policy advice.

integrity.description: Verify the agent actually ran SUMO simulations rather than fabricating numbers.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal logs showing 'sumo' or 'sumo-gui' commands being executed with the specific configuration files for Pasubio.

integrity.description: Check that the CSV values match the data seen in the XML emission files.
integrity.visual_evidence: The numerical values for total emissions in the XML files should correspond to the 'total_mg' values in the CSV report.

integrity.description: Ensure the agent didn't just create empty files or files with placeholder text.
integrity.visual_evidence: The content of the CSV and TXT files should contain specific numerical data and professional analysis, not just headers.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires working within /home/ga/SUMO_Scenarios/bologna_pasubio/. The agent must modify at least 5 edges and use 2 distinct strategies (e.g., edge-based bans and vType modifications). Required output files are baseline_emissions.xml, lez_emissions.xml, emission_impact_report.csv (must include CO2, CO, NOx, PMx, HC), and emission_impact_summary.txt. The agent is acting as an ARPAE environmental scientist.
